questions.qtext: The faulty ammeter in secondary of a current transformer (C.T) is replaced by

options.text: Open circuit the secondary of the C.T and replace it.
Never short circuit the secondary of C.T while primary is energized.
A short circuiting link is provided on secondary for replacing the faulty ammeter.
It is not possible with out interrupting the line supply.

questions.solution:
When secondary of CT is made open but primary carrying current, the secondary MMF developed is zero. As secondary MMF is zero the primary MMF will be used to produced large flux which induces high emf, but the insulation of CT is not able to with stand such high voltages. A short
circuiting link is provided on secondary for replacing the faulty ammeter so that primary MMF is balanced by secondary MMF.
